All references to “CF Holdings,” “we,” “us,” “our” and “the Company” refer to CF Industries Holdings, Inc. and its subsidiaries, except where the context makes clear that the reference is to CF Industries Holdings, Inc. only and not its subsidiaries. All references to “CF Industries” refer to CF Industries, Inc., a 100% owned subsidiary of CF Industries Holdings, Inc. References to tons refer to short tons. Notes referenced in this discussion and analysis refer to the notes to consolidated financial statements that are found in Item 8. For a discussion and analysis of the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, see Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations in our 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on February 20, 2025. The following is an outline of the discussion and analysis included herein: • Overview of CF Holdings • Market Conditions and Current Developments • Financial Executive Summary • Items Affecting Comparability of Results • Consolidated Results of Operations • Operating Results by Business Segment • Liquidity and Capital Resources • Critical Accounting Estimates • Recent Accounting Pronouncements Overview of CF Holdings Our Company Our mission is to provide clean energy to feed and fuel the world sustainably. With our employees focused on safe and reliable operations, environmental stewardship, and disciplined capital and corporate management, we are on a path to decarbonize our ammonia production network – the world’s largest – to enable low-carbon hydrogen and nitrogen products for energy, fertilizer, emissions abatement, and other industrial activities. Our value chain consists of manufacturing complexes in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom, an extensive storage, transportation and distribution network in North America, and logistics capabilities enabling a global reach. In July 2025, we completed a significant decarbonization project at our Donaldsonville, Louisiana, complex to enable the production of low-carbon ammonia. Additionally, we are executing further decarbonization projects in our existing network and constructing a greenfield low-carbon ammonia plant at our Blue Point complex to drive our strategy to leverage our unique capabilities to accelerate the world’s transition to clean energy. Our principal customers are cooperatives, retailers, independent fertilizer distributors, traders, wholesalers and industrial users. Our core product is anhydrous ammonia (ammonia), which contains 82% nitrogen and 18% hydrogen. Products derived from ammonia that are most often used as nitrogen fertilizers include granular urea, urea ammonium nitrate solution (UAN) and ammonium nitrate (AN). credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage sits well below the sector median and improved year over year, reflecting modest borrowings against a large ammonia manufacturing EBITDA base. The balance sheet carries limited absolute debt relative to the scale of the nitrogen production network, leaving substantial headroom before the next risk-band boundary.

Operating margin exceeds the sector median and improved year over year, supported by the low-cost North American ammonia position and completed Donaldsonville low-carbon project. Cash conversion is strong, with operating cash flow covering capital spending and shareholder distributions combined.

key_risks.text: The business is a commodity nitrogen producer whose earnings track ammonia and urea prices, natural gas input costs and global trade flows. Revenue rebounded sharply year over year after a prior decline, showing cyclicality that could compress EBITDA and coverage if fertilizer pricing weakens.

Shareholder returns are large relative to internally generated cash: buybacks plus dividends absorb most free cash flow, leaving a thin residual buffer. Continued decarbonization and greenfield ammonia construction at Blue Point add discretionary capital calls that compete with distributions for the same cash.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is comfortably above the sector median and edged higher year over year, with operating income dwarfing gross interest expense. Even a severe EBITDA decline would leave coverage intact, so debt service is not a near-term constraint on the credit.

Free cash flow to debt is well above the sector median, and operating cash flow covers debt service many times over. Liquidity is ample, with a current ratio far above the sector median and cash balances covering a large share of reported borrowings.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, with net leverage far below the sector median and improving, and cash flow to debt strong. Headroom to the next risk-band boundary is wide on both leverage and cash-flow measures, so the credit tolerates meaningful earnings volatility.

Our judgement is a stable, high-quality credit profile anchored by low leverage and strong coverage, tempered by commodity price exposure and heavy distributions. Debt maturities are not disclosed in the bundle, so refinancing timing cannot be assessed; this gap is material to the liquidity view.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，並按年改善，反映相對於龐大的氨製造 EBITDA 基礎而言借款規模適中。資產負債表相對於氮肥生產網絡的規模，絕對債務水平有限，距離下一個風險區間邊界仍有充裕空間。
營業利潤率超過行業中位數並按年改善，受惠於低成本北美氨業務定位及已完成的 Donaldsonville 低碳項目。現金轉換強勁，經營現金流足以覆蓋資本開支與股東分派之總和。

key_risks.text: 該業務為大宗商品氮肥生產商，其盈利跟隨氨及尿素價格、天然氣投入成本及全球貿易流向。收入在先前下跌後按年大幅反彈，顯示出週期性；若肥料價格轉弱，可能壓縮 EBITDA 及覆蓋率。
股東回報相對於內部產生現金而言規模龐大：回購加股息吸收大部分自由現金流，留下微薄的剩餘緩衝。持續減碳及 Blue Point 的綠地氨建設帶來額外酌情資本需求，與分派爭奪同一筆現金。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率穩居行業中位數之上，並按年略為上升，營業利潤遠超總利息支出。即使 EBITDA 嚴重下滑，覆蓋率仍可維持，因此償債並非近期對信貸的約束。
自由現金流對債務比率遠高於行業中位數，經營現金流覆蓋償債多倍。流動性充裕，流動比率遠高於行業中位數，現金結餘覆蓋所報告借款的很大部分。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，淨槓桿遠低於行業中位數且持續改善，現金流對債務強勁。無論在槓桿還是現金流指標上，距離下一個風險區間邊界的空間均寬闊，因此該信貸可承受顯著的盈利波動。
我們的判斷是穩定、優質的信貸狀況，以低槓桿及強勁覆蓋率為錨，但受商品價格敞口及沉重分派所制約。資料包未披露債務到期結構，因此無法評估再融資時機；此缺口對流動性觀點屬重大。
